title: District Plan and Maps
previewText: The regulations of this Chapter are designed to implement the Special Hudson Square District Plan. The District Plan includes the map, “Special Hudson Square District and Subdistrict,” in the Appendix to this Chapter which is hereby incorporated and made part of this Resolution for the purpose of specifying locations where the special regulations and requirements set forth in this Chapter apply.
